gpu: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (sm_120, 188 SMs, 96 GB)
model: gemma-4-12B-it fp8 (e4m3 weight-only + E5 fp8 lm_head + fp8-KV)
method: gemma4_sm120_chat, PREFILL buckets then 128 gen, first 16 discarded, n=112, mean/median/sd

dims_12b.note: brief 'down K=9728' is Qwen3-4B; 12B down K=15360, o_proj K=4096

ladder_mean_ms.note: mean ms/token n=112; sd<=0.026 at every point; argmax device==host AGREE all

threshold.note: conservative; GF8 engages only where measured to win; linear break-even ~49k

switch_cost.method: alternate GF2/GF8 every step vs mean of the two pure runs
switch_cost.verdict: per-step function+program switch is free (<=0.02 ms, within noise)

mechanisms.A_interpreter_relaunch: CHOSEN — per-step CUfunction switch, cost 0 measured
mechanisms.B_runseg: REJECTED for decode — segments WITHIN a step (wave-class); ctx is BETWEEN-step (kvlen); per-layer relaunch ~100/step, decode is single-launch latency-bound
mechanisms.C_emit_side_two_decode_programs: USED — GF2 needs ns47, GF8 needs ns94; two decode programs share one tensor table (opart sized by prefill); free selection

correctness.switch_mechanism_pre_boundary: byte-exact vs fixed-GF2 (7 tokens + prefill, ctx16384 thresh16392)
correctness.token_identity_natural_text: 64/64 tokens identical across GF2, GF8, switched (214-tok prose, thresh230)
correctness.gf8_near_tie_high_entropy: 128k-random greedy flips within a few steps — documented class (== fp8-KV drift, GF8 step-0 logit near-tie)
correctness.argmax_device_host: AGREE at all 7 points x {GF2, GF8, switched}
correctness.op_test: sm120_interp_op_test ok (shared op bodies; GF8 delta is flash template param, validated by microbench+argmax)

gemv_review.microbench: gemv_fp8_bw_12b.cu, grid=188, M=1 arena path, L2-flushed cold HBM read, min-of-300
gemv_review.cause: small-N SM-fill / HBM-latency-hiding wall at occ-1; cold GB/s monotone in rows/block; o_proj/down write N=hidden=3840 -> ~2.5 rows/warp -> cannot hide ~500ns cold-read latency; loads already 256B-coalesced, dequant is HW cvt (L2-hot same kernel does 1355-2850 GB/s)
gemv_review.uint4_verdict: NO-GO (latency-bound not issue-bound; +2.5%/-3.5% wash, one regression)
gemv_review.real_lever: split-K decode GEMV (K-reduction across more blocks + merge) — a new op, not a cheap fix; occ-1 megakernel can't add occupancy simply
gemv_review.verdict: at the small-N floor; ship nothing; aggregate GEMV already ~90% of fp8-byte ceiling weighted by achievable-per-shape
